tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Palette swatch sampled from the reference image: dark panel ground.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Palette swatch sampled from the reference image: raised panels.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Palette swatch sampled from the reference image: hover and selected panel fills.

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Palette swatch sampled from the reference image: deep blue fills, large blocks.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Palette swatch sampled from the reference image: ring and circuit lines on dark grounds, large blocks.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Palette swatch: electric blue, the `brand` fill in the dark theme.

tokens.name: blue-400
tokens.usage: Palette swatch sampled from the reference image: mid-blue strokes and borders on dark grounds.

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Palette swatch sampled from the reference image: soft blue highlights and tints.

tokens.name: cyan-400
tokens.usage: Palette swatch sampled from the reference image: the luminous cyan, `accent` in the dark theme.

tokens.name: cyan-200

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every card and panel. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `ink-subtle`, `accent`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default card, table and panel fill. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `ink-subtle`, `accent`, status colors.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, hovered rows, nested tiles and secondary buttons on `surface`. Same text rules as `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, selected rows and toggle tracks. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `accent`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, table row dividers, section rules. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and toggles. At least 3:1 on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-overlay`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, helper text, table cells. On every surface above and on `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: eyebrow labels, axis labels, timestamps. 4.5:1 on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-overlay`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive accent: links, active nav, primary button fill, focus and progress strokes. Text on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-overlay`, `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `accent` fills and accent links.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of `accent` fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind active nav items, ghost-button hover and accent badges. Text on it: `accent`, `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an `accent` fill (primary button). Not white: cyan needs dark text.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Electric-blue fill for large brand surfaces, illustrations and the cover. Text on it: `on-brand`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a `brand` fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Two-pixel focus outline on every interactive element. At least 3:1 on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-overlay` in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Critical severity, destructive actions, errors. Text and icons on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `danger-bg`. Always paired with an icon and the word.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind critical badges and error alerts. Text on it: `danger`, `ink`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: High severity, caution. Text and icons on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `warning-bg`. Always paired with an icon and the word.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind high-severity badges and warning alerts. Text on it: `warning`, `ink`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Secure, resolved, healthy. A teal, not a pure green, so it separates from `danger` away from the red-green axis. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `success-bg`. Always paired with an icon and the word.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind clear and resolved badges and success alerts. Text on it: `success`, `ink`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Medium severity, neutral notices. Text and icons on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `info-bg`. Always paired with an icon and the word.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind medium-severity badges and info alerts. Text on it: `info`, `ink`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and drawers.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series and the hero series. Cyan in dark, deep teal-blue in light. Marks need 3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second data series: amber. Differs from `chart-1` in lightness and hue.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third data series: coral red. Use for threat or loss series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth data series: periwinkle blue.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth data series: neutral slate, for baselines and totals.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero numerals and page titles on marketing and onboarding screens. One per screen.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section titles on dashboards and report covers.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Table group headers, list titles, nav section titles.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, helper text, dense lists.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrow labels and table headers. Set in uppercase (the `.ae-label` class does it).

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: The headline number in a stat tile or score ring.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: IP addresses, hashes, log lines, timestamps in tables, API keys.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Inline code and terse log metadata.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside badges and between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row; compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input padding, gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Bento grid gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large section separation.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code chips and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items, table row hover, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, alerts, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and tables.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Floating nav rail, modals, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, toggles.

tokens.name: glow-sm
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and active nav items. A cyan glow in dark, a hairline lift in light.

tokens.name: glow-md
tokens.usage: The one highlighted card per view and the score ring.

tokens.name: elev-card
tokens.usage: Resting elevation of cards and tables.

tokens.name: inset-edge
tokens.usage: Top edge light on cards, adds the glass feel.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur for floating nav and overlays: `backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-glass))`.
